newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki basks in broad post-Greenspan exuberance.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki basks in broad post-Greenspan exuberance.

text.p: Shares rose across the board in lively early trade on Wednesday and brokers saw more upside as European markets took off on an air-clearing message from U.S. Fed chief Alan Greenspan overnight.
The FOX index rose 16 points or 1.38 percent but was still 23 points short of its all-time July 17 high of 1,226.84 points.
"Interest rates are falling, stock markets are rising, the sun is shining and everything is fine," one broker said.
Blue-chips led the rally, with Nokia gaining 4.00 markka to 427.00, Merita adding 1.00 markka to 23.00 and UPM-Kymmene rising 2.40 to 134.00.
Raisio recovered from a brief dip to trade up 3.00 markka at 608.00 in brisk 16 million markka dealings.
The strong dollar continued to support cyclicals in particular, brokers said.
